notes.title: Update patch 3 is LIVE
notes.notes:
This is a quick patch for fixing some minor issues that was reported by the community.

The fixes includes:
- Removing screen marker after first mission completion
- Enabling options button in the pause menu
- Horse object is more optimized now
- Balancing horse power and damage
- Enabling mouse sensitivity control
- Fixing pause menu

Thank you so much for your patience with us and we are awaiting your feedback on this patch.

notes.title: Update patch 2 is LIVE
notes.notes:
This is a [b]MAJOR[/b] important patch for addressing the optimization issues and frame drops that was reported by the community along with some extra minor fixes.

The optimizations includes:
- Adjusted characters poly count
- Optimized characters shading
- Rock materials shading is more optimized

The fixes includes:
- Enabling sound settings
- Cut-scenes fades on skipping
- Fixed random loud music volume
- Disabling Steam VR API
- Fixed continue button functionality
- Berserk mode allows player to attack
- Aligned map labels correctly
- Tweaked swords sounds
- Prevented walking through the river

Thank you so much for your patience with us and we are awaiting your feedback on this important patch.
